objective: Identify and reduce hitches reported on joining/leaving both forms of group across FluxUI. Broader goal remains active pending matching native evidence.

nativeAttribution.scope: Previously saved Forever spikeWatch. Read existing saved diagnostic root only. No fresh R75 group transition or CPU capture.
nativeAttribution.interpretation: Historical callback times identify the builder. Heap values include the full captured environment and cannot attribute allocations to FluxUI or native work. R74/R75 live performance remains unverified.

additionalAudit.border: Read actual Solve, plan and commit path beyond the R74 event owners. Regional clip preparation rescanned all pieces/ops per tile. Warm query repeatedly allocated padded bounds.
additionalAudit.focus: PositionContainer calls the focus aura layout helper on roster changes. UpdateAuraPosition cleared and re-added both anchors and rewrote already-matching panel sizes.
additionalAudit.raid: The native unit attribute callback binds event filters before reveal. The reveal callback redundantly installed them and could immediately replace them if it discovered a different unit.
additionalAudit.other: Reviewed native compact-grid suppression, mouseover routing recovery, range, adjunct aura/HoT/MTMA paint and direct event owners from R74. Keep live ownership and recovery.
